mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_upload (file_md5, file_name, total_size, status, user_id, is_public, created_at) VALUES (#{fileMd5}, #{fileName}, #{totalSize}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{isPublic}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM file_upload WHERE file_md5 = #{fileMd5} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM file_upload WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM file_upload WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
